correctness.rationale: The exact Rule 22 space-time constraint yields a finite 1024-vertex fifth-return transfer graph. Exhaustive SCC and simple-cycle certificate gives one 1-loop, one 2-cycle and five 16-vertex components, each having exactly three mutually intersecting simple cycles of lengths 11,12,13. Determinant and trace identities prove the renewal series; five prime-time phases justify the 1/5 orbit normalization. The interval-semigroup proof shows conductor 55, with 54 excluded. Complete code was executed; independently structured direct enumeration matches through n=22. The finite test is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Period-five is a natural prime return time for the canonical Rule 22 automaton. The unexpected three-loop renewal structure gives a sharp arithmetic classification with final absent circumference 54, an exact all-size count and an explicit exponential rate. These are mathematically motivated nontrivial finite-state deductions and not the already published isolated examples at n=11,12,13.
